prompt: I have an existing migration-manifest.yaml for the dashboards repo. We finished cleanup and the MR is merged. The GitHub repo already exists and has content pushed. What's next?

assertions.text: Reads the existing manifest rather than creating a new one
Shows a status summary with cleanup and github_setup marked complete
Does NOT re-run Phase 0 or re-initialize
Identifies quay_oidc as the next phase to work on
Presents guidance for the first quay_oidc item (Create Quay repo)
Notes that quay_repo_exists is true, suggesting the Quay repo step may be skippable
